description: Incident reporting mechanisms are not established to require personnel to report suspected security incidents to appropriate organizational authorities.
applicability: This signal applies to: Cloud Service Providers seeking FedRAMP authorization Federal agencies using cloud services Third-party assessment organizations (3PAOs) Systems processing federal information

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for missing incident reporting procedures, absence of reporting timelines, lack of defined reporting channels, and missing documentation on incident escalation paths.
